schedule: always-on daemon (FastAPI on 127.0.0.1:8773) started by the stream watchdog like the other cluster servers
notes: Server-cluster monitor area (python -m server_cluster.monitor; added 2026-11): the ops surface. Owns the shared jobs surface for the database.*/llm_agents.*/test.* modules (the data_viz API's former local WSL spawns — run-guard runs, AI Ask, external-resources refresh, database.monitoring). Its own routers add GET /health-check (the structured fleet health items from database.monitoring.HealthCheck), GET /residents (all areas' /processes + llm/config /health merged with heartbeat beats), POST /residents/ensure-up (start every desired-running resident that is down), and POST /orchestration/run (serial tier runner over scripts/orchestration/*.json, the retired run_steps.sh semantics; the maintainer nightly_pipeline chain drives it at 16:00 China time on trading days). (The daily 07:00 ensure-up scheduler moved to the maintainer area 2026-11 — server_cluster.maintainer fires this endpoint and appends the pass to monitor.service_audit.) One instance only — the registration guard auto-exits a second run.
